result.summary: The screen renders mostly correctly, but the 'Fastest near you' carousel shows a duplicated restaurant entry and clipped content, and there are minor inconsistencies in card styling and horizontal overflow handling.

issues.description: The 'Fastest near you' carousel shows 'Green Bowl Poké' twice with identical 15–25 min ETA, €0.90 delivery and identical placeholder imagery, suggesting duplicated data in the list.
issues.suggestion: De-duplicate results by restaurant ID before rendering the carousel, and verify the API is not returning the same venue twice.

issues.description: The third carousel card ('Smash Bros Bu...') is cut hard at the right screen edge with its title and delivery text truncated mid-word and no trailing gutter, so it looks broken rather than intentionally scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add horizontal padding/peek offset to the scroll container so the next card is partially visible with rounded edges, and truncate titles with an ellipsis instead of a hard clip.

issues.description: The category filter chip row is also clipped at the right edge, showing only a sliver of the next chip with no visual affordance that it scrolls.
issues.suggestion: Add end padding and/or a fade/gradient mask on the chip row to signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: Favorite (heart) buttons are styled inconsistently: the ramen card uses a white circular button while the pizza card below uses a dark circular button.
issues.suggestion: Use a single consistent favourite button style (e.g. translucent white background with dark icon) across all restaurant cards.

issues.description: Restaurant images in the 'Fastest near you' row appear to be generic grey placeholder illustrations rather than real venue photos, and two are identical.
issues.suggestion: Load actual venue imagery, and provide distinct branded fallbacks when an image is unavailable.

issues.description: Secondary text such as '€0.90 delivery' and the 'DELIVER TO' label uses light grey on white, which may fall below the 4.5:1 contrast requirement.
issues.suggestion: Darken the muted grey text tone to meet WCAG AA contrast for small text.
